nonContextRule.simplePara: BRDP-S1-00001. Decide whether and when to use the alpha characters "I" and "O".
Decision made by TDWG.
BRDP-S1-00003. Decide which issue or issues of S1000D to be used.
Decision made by TDWG.
BRDP-S1-00004. Decide which information sets, given in S1000D and/or project specific, to be used.
Decision made by Project. Infosets required - Common Information and Data - Description and Operation - Fault Isolation (later stage) - Illustrated Parts Data - Maintenance Procedures
BRDP-S1-00005. Decide which publications to be produced.
Decision made by Project. PDF export optional
BRDP-S1-00007. Decide whether and how to use each optional element and attribute in its structural context.
Decision made by TDWG.

BRDP-S1-00008. Decide on the possible deliverables, such as: S1000D objects (eg, data modules, publication modules, illustration sheets and multimedia objects, data management lists) using file based transfer. Page-oriented publications and/or interactive electronic technical publications.
Decision made by Project. PDF export optional
BRDP-S1-00009. Decide on the frequency of data exchanges.
Decision made by Project. Exchange on demand.
BRDP-S1-00010. Decide whether to use a zoning and access identification system.
Decision made by Project. Zoning rules shall not be applied for CMPs
BRDP-S1-00011. Decide which method to use for zoning and identifying access points.
Decision made by Project. Zoning rules shall not be applied for CMPs
BRDP-S1-00013. Determine how the security classifications will be used.
Decision made by TDWG.
BRDP-S1-00014. Determine if the policies that apply to security marking, instructions, etc, and how those markings are required to be applied within the given project.
Decision made by Project. Caveats shall not be applied.
BRDP-S1-00015. Decide on the retention of security classifications.
Decision made by TDWG.
BRDP-S1-00016. Decide on how the security classifications will be marked and/or indicated.
Decision made by Project. Shall not be displayed.
BRDP-S1-00017. Decide on the rules for QA of data modules and deliverables.

Decision made by Project. CMP: For draft deliveries, "Unverified" is acceptable. For issued DMs, only first verification will be used, and the verification type will be "Tabletop", "On-Object", or "Tabletop and On- Object".

BRDP-S1-00018. Decide on the rules for first and second verification. For example, such a rule might be that all data modules that have a safety related procedure must have first verification carried out "On object".

Decision made by Project. CMP: For draft deliveries, "Unverified" is acceptable. For issued DMs, only first verification will be used, and the verification type will be "Tabletop", "On-Object", or "Tabletop and On- Object".
BRDP-S1-00019. Decide on the review cycle processes and procedures.
Decision made by TDWG.
BRDP-S1-00020. Decide which language to use for producing data modules.
Decision made by Project. All data modules must be written in U.S. English.
BRDP-S1-00021. Decide whether to use ASD-STE100® when producing data modules in English.
Decision made by Project. All Procedural data modules must use the writing rules and vocabulary in ASD Simplified Technical English (ASD-STE100). Use of STE is optional for other data module types
BRDP-S1-00022. Decide which standard dictionary to use for producing data modules.
Decision made by TDWG.
BRDP-S1-00023. Decide whether to use a terminology database or a glossary. If used, agree on its content and management.
Decision made by Project. The ATA Common Support Data Dictionary shall be used for Civil Aviation maintenance terminology
BRDP-S1-00024. Decide whether to use a standard list of abbreviations. If used, agree on its content and management.
Decision made by TDWG.
BRDP-S1-00025. Decide what unit of measurement to use for primary and secondary units.
Decision made by Project. Measurements shall be provided in both S.I. (metric) and Imperial/U.S. units. The first value shall be in the units used in the original design.
BRDP-S1-00026. Decide on which method to be used to emphasize text.
Decision made by Project. Bold text only shall be used to emphasize text. Overline text may be used only for marking vectors.
BRDP-S1-00027. Decide which parts of the documentation (data modules and publications including IETP) need to be printable.
Decision made by Project. All content DMC need to be convertible to PDF: PMC, descript, proced, fault, IPD
BRDP-S1-00028. Decide if schematics derived from engineering drawings include the original drawing number and revision status within the illustration reproduction area.
Decision made by Project. shall be included
BRDP-S1-00029. Decide whether to use color in the final deliverable.
Decision made by Project. The use of color is permitted in accordance with the ATA iSpec 2200 3-1-12.4 Graphic Style Standards.
BRDP-S1-00030. Decide whether to produce general warnings, cautions and notes in separate descriptive data modules.
Decision made by Project. No DM with general warnings and cautions shall be produced.
BRDP-S1-00031. Decide whether to use warning and/or caution collections, internal or external.
Decision made by Project. A Warnings and Cautions Common Information Repositories (CIRs) shall be used.
BRDP-S1-00036. Decide whether to present the issue number with or without the inwork number on the title page.
Decision made by Project. The issue number shall be presented on the title page. The inwork number may only be presented in unreleased documents.
BRDP-S1-00037. Decide whether the use of LOEP or LOEDM.
Decision made by Project. LOEDM is not being used. The LOEP is part of the final PDF delivery, but not available as a physical DM.
BRDP-S1-00038. Decide whether to present the issue date or the issue number (with or without inwork number) for the LOEP entries.
Decision made by TDWG.
BRDP-S1-00039. Decide whether to present the applicability information for the LOEP entries.
Decision made by TDWG.
BRDP-S1-00040. Decide whether to present the issue date or the issue number (with or without inwork number) for the LOEDM entries.
Decision made by Project. Both issue date and issue number are required. Inwork number shall not be presented.
BRDP-S1-00041. Decide whether to present the applicability information for the LOEDM entries.
Decision made by TDWG.
BRDP-S1-00042. Decide whether to use Highlights with updating instructions or not.
Decision made by Project. Highlights with updating instructions shall not be used.
BRDP-S1-00043. Decide whether to present the issue date or the issue number (with or without inwork number) for the Highlights entries.
Decision made by Project. Not applicable (refer to BRDP-S1-00042).
BRDP-S1-00044. Decide whether to present the applicability information for the Highlights entries.
Decision made by Project. Not applicable (refer to BRDP-S1-00042).
BRDP-S1-00045. Decide whether to present the issue date and/or the issue number (with or without inwork number) that apply to the TOC entries.
Decision made by Project. Both issue date and issue number are required. Inwork number shall not be presented.
BRDP-S1-00046. Decide whether to use a linear or a hierarchically subdivided TOC.
Decision made by Project. For CMP, a hierarchical TOC shall be used.
BRDP-S1-00048. Decide whether the project will allow the exchange of draft data modules.
Decision made by Project. Exchange of draft DM with supplier of DM. inWork different from 00 allowed.
BRDP-S1-00049. Decide on the definition of the issue date. This can be, for example, the input date (ie, the release to CSDB date), or the cut-off date for the delivery, etc.
Decision made by Project. For CMP, DMs the definition of the issue date is the date it is released.
BRDP-S1-00050. Decide on the source of the technical names and use them consistently across the project. In all cases, the technical name must reflect the item represented by the SNS.
Decision made by TDWG.
BRDP-S1-00051. Decide on which information codes apply to the project.
Decision made by TDWG.
BRDP-S1-00055. Decide on the priorities and relationships between the attributes securityClassification, commercialClassification and caveat if they are used.
Decision made by Project. securityClassification must always be 01.
BRDP-S1-00057. Decide whether to differentiate data restrictions information based on Product configuration.
Decision made by Project. N/A, since no applicability is being used.
BRDP-S1-00058. Decide whether to include export controls, handling, destruction notices and disclosure instructions.
Decision made by TDWG.
BRDP-S1-00059. Decide on the distribution information contained in the element <dataDistribution>.
Decision made by TDWG.
BRDP-S1-00060. Decide whether and how to use the element <dataHandling>. For example, the handling requirements and procedures that must be applied to a data module.
Decision made by TDWG.
BRDP-S1-00061. Decide whether to use the element <dataDestruction> and how to use it. For example, the appropriate extent of destruction instructions that must be applied to a data module.
Decision made by TDWG.
BRDP-S1-00062. Decide whether and how to use the element <dataDisclosure>. For example, the requirements that must be applied to a data module with regard to disclosure instructions.
Decision made by TDWG.
BRDP-S1-00063. Decide whether to use the element <supersedure> and how to use it. For example, the requirements that must be applied to a data module with regard to supersedure notices.
Decision made by TDWG.
BRDP-S1-00064. Decide whether and how to use the element <restrictionInfo>. For example, the content and extent of restriction information to include in a data module.
Decision made by Project. <restrictionInfo> shall be used for incorporating the copyright.

BRDP-S1-00066. Decide whether to populate copyright information in each data module or whether to cross-reference to a copyright data module. Note While choosing the population method, assess the impact of changes to copyright information on updating of data modules.
Decision made by Project. Copyright shall be contained in all DM.
BRDP-S1-00067. Decide whether to use the element <policyStatement>.
Decision made by Project. <policyStatement> shall not be used.
BRDP-S1-00068. Decide whether to use the element <dataConds>.
Decision made by Project. <dataConds> shall not be used.
BRDP-S1-00069. Decide whether to use the element <logo>and how it should be used at presentation.
Decision made by Project. <logo> shall not be used
